items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley expected to return to practice Thursday and in line to play Monday vs Cowboys (missed last two with hamstring).
items.why: Hamstring progressing; sources confirm practice return and play expectation.
items.implication: RB1 return boosts Eagles offense with Hurts out.
items.opportunity: Full backfield lead role likely vs Dallas.

items.text: Rams WR Davante Adams ruptured hamstring, out 6-10 weeks per McVay; procedure upcoming. TE Terrance Ferguson (IR eligible soon) recovery 'will take some time' and not expected ready immediately.
items.implication: Major target vacuum in Rams offense.
items.opportunity: Puka Nacua primary beneficiary for volume.

items.text: Commanders WR Terry McLaurin suffered torn patellar tendon, out for season after MRI; surgery needed. Carted off Week 6 MNF.
items.why: Torn left patellar tendon confirmed Tuesday.
items.implication: Season over; Diggs becomes clear WR1, more opportunity for depth WRs.
items.opportunity: Stefon Diggs and secondary WRs see role expansion.

items.text: Lamar Jackson present for start of Thursday practice (after no-show Wednesday); promising update amid ankle recovery.
items.why: Showed up Thursday after missing Wed start.
items.implication: Increasing chance to play Week 7; monitor further.
items.opportunity: Ravens offense returns to full if cleared.

items.text: Breaks down Commanders offense fantasy impact after McLaurin season-ending injury; feels terrible for him but analyzes remaining pieces.
items.implication: Shift targets/usage to Diggs and others; Daniels upside may change.

items.text: Bears RB Kyle Monangai ruled out Thursday night vs Patriots; misses third straight (thumb/turf toe). Return coming soon per reports.
items.implication: More work for Swift and Bears RBs on TNF.

items.text: With Ferguson delayed further post-Adams injury, Rams' only answer is 25 Puka Nacua targets per game.
items.why: Ferguson was biggest potential beneficiary but recovery delayed; no other clear options.
items.implication: Elite WR1 upside spike for Puka ROS/weekly.

items.text: Cam Skattebo benched (no carries Week 6 after fumbles), Najee Harris released after starting and criticizing committee; Giants RB room in flux with Tracy/Singletary.
items.why: Fumbles and poor efficiency led to benching; Harris comments then release.
items.implication: Unclear lead back; avoid or monitor closely.
items.opportunity: Potential rebound for Skattebo or Tracy with Harris gone.

items.text: Bhayshul Tuten usage keeps rising every week; passing-game involvement stands out as why he is legit. Love the trend.
items.implication: Rising RB/flex value; waiver or hold priority.

items.text: Week 7 snaps/pace: Up in pace TB@CAR; slow slogs MIA@NYJ. Other notes; full Thorman analysis. Rams@LV also volume-friendly post-Adams.
items.why: Neutral pace/PROE data and recent trends.
items.implication: Prefer high-pace games for volume; avoid slogs.
items.opportunity: Elevated snap potential in TB/CAR, GB/DET, LAR/LV.

items.text: Keeping it OPEN on Tony Pollard reluctantly; volume and bye weeks keep him in low-end RB2/Flex conversation.
Give me Caleb Williams in battle of 2024 first-round QBs on TNF; start lean.
Giants plan to start JJ McCarthy vs Houston. Notes historically low 5.7 YPT when McCarthy threw to Justin Jefferson (vs 9.9-10.8 for others); scheme/coaches different but hard to ignore.
items.why: Small sample low efficiency to elite WR previously.
items.implication: Caution on Jefferson if related, but different context now.
items.conflict: Usage data may override prior YPT concern.

items.text: Bears Week 10 bye then soft close: Saints (27th YPP allwd), Lions (24th), Jags (26th), Dolphins (21st), Bills (25th), Packers (3rd), Lions. Strong early scoring when healthy.
items.implication: Boost ROS rankings for Bears skill players.
